subject: Environmental Data for Transfer to a New Time

messages.subject: Environmental Data for Transfer to a New Time
parts:
Hello,
I am trying to run analysis on some plant species with small ranges, and the 0.5 degree resolution of ecoClimate is removing a lot of already scarce data points, making my analysis more difficult. However, I want to use the ecoClimate variables when transferring to a new time, since I want to be able to model in the past. Is it possible to use Bioclims for the background environmental data and then use ecoClimate to project the model to another time, or will this mess up the analysis?
Thank you!
